newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/237f92facdbf44ba70bfc1b09d60c1bdc25374ca.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Content[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Ticketopia Event[/p][/*][*][p]End of Electrostorm[/p][/*][*][p]Working Man’s Cut on NA server[/p][/*][*][p]1000 level style — Air Seller[/p][/*][*][p]New quest — Shock wave [/p][/*][*][p]Economy, rewards and progression[/p][/*][*][p]Modification window update[/p][/*][*][p]Making Safe Zone more lively[/p][/*][*][p]Balance changes[/p][/*][*][p]Other changes and fixes[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Ticketopia Event[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a9fbab5406ab5493254a1eab1edbd05220fd90fa.png"][/img][/p][p]In autumn, not only leaves fall from the trees, but also Act Tickets, which can be obtained for PvE challenges or for challenges in the Coliseum. The event will run from October 14 to 28.[/p][p]There will be 16 challenges in the event, 8 for each format. You can complete them in any combination: either 8 in PvE, or 8 in the Coliseum, or 4 and 4.[/p][h3][b]Locations to complete PvE challenges[/b][/h3][p]They are only available in the North, Wild North and Lyubech-3. Challenges will not be completed in the peaceful South. Also, the reward does not depend on the selected location.[/p][h3][b]What challenges will there be[/b][/h3][list][*][p]PvE: only open-world activities not tied to direct competition with other players. Outposts, airdrops, and installations in the Wild North do not count.[/p][/*][*][p]Coliseum: destroying enemy squads, capturing installations, activating rifts, and other tasks.[/p][/*][/list][p]The remaining challenges will be announced when the event begins.[/p][h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3][p]For each completed challenge, a small reward is given. Larger rewards are granted for reaching certain milestones of completed challenges:[/p][list][*][p]2 challenges: 100 Act Tickets[/p][/*][*][p]4 challenges: 150 Act Tickets[/p][/*][*][p]6 challenges: Veil style for Albatross Interceptor. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ed413b6d3ad14b1b6d1736cec72067dc8d891111.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]8 challenges: 250 Act Tickets[/p][/*][/list][p]To claim the main prizes, you only need to complete any 8 out of 16 challenges, freely mixing both formats.[/p][h1][b]End of Electrostorm[/b][/h1][p]The event has come to an end. The styles that were obtainable during the event can now be sold to Zen in exchange for season currency.[/p][h1]Working Man’s Cut on NA server[/h1][p]Honest workers deserve honest rewards. A new event where ordinary North hard workers can get everything they're owed for the work they do every day.[/p][p]At Mines, Inflow, Black Detour and Reflection events yield 20% more income — signals and stashes appear 20% more frequently as well. And don't forget about deliveries: even light cargo is valued three times higher.[/p][p]Challenges can only be completed at Mines, Inflow, Black Detour and Reflection.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/699b46c88139282efe897fe430fb2118387b1340.png"][/img][/p][p]Completing challenges rewards you with anomalous serum and other valuable resources. This event is planned to run regularly, and your activity and feedback can influence this.[/p][h1][b]1000 level style — Air Seller[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/48ad7774614fe63d06512b7500b7f65cdf78c87c.png"][/img][/p][p]It's unknown how much the crafter loved Belyaev's books, but that's exactly what he named his creation.[/p][p]The gun reliably produces an air base, enough to subdue enemies without using gunpowder. Those lucky ones who held it says it coughs slightly — something the gunsmith always denies.[/p][h1][b]New quest — Shock wave [/b][/h1][p]Gunfire can be heard near the base — right at the walls! Who could it be? The answer to this question will drag you into a whirlwind of industrial espionage and intrigues among the big players. And as everyone knows, the most unpleasant secrets are hidden under the biggest carpet. Like what happened at Forge-11 when the sky began to fall...[/p][h1][b]Economy, rewards and progression[/b][/h1][p]We've reworked the reward system and economy to make progression across locations more tangible and strengthen the position of the Faction North. Certain activities have also received a significant reward buff. [/p][p][b]Now you're farming more than before. [/b]Here's why:[/p][p]Previously, inventories got clogged with junk — small items took up space and were worth almost nothing.[/p][p]According to the analytics data, players did not claim nearly half of the event rewards due to their low value and excess inventory space.[/p][p]We've reworked rewards on the Faction North, aligning them ideologically with Wild North rewards. Fillers now take up less space and are worth more — the value of a player's inventory relative to its weight has increased.[/p][p][b]Let's show the numbers using Mines as an example: [/b][/p][p]Let’s say you came to a location and cleared 100 events: previously, just under half of the items awarded as rewards for clearing events were of extremely low value. As a result, receiving them was often seen more as a burden than a useful reward: players frequently sent such items to the Trash to avoid taking up inventory space.[/p][p]With the update to the reward pool, the value of the items awarded will increase, making it worthwhile for players to collect each one.[/p][p]The tables below show the results of our calculations for two scenarios: under current player behavior, where low-value items are not collected, and after the reward system is changed, when players will collect all awarded items.[/p][p][b]Mutants[/b] — previously loot occupied 66 inventory slots and was worth 152 thousand. Now it takes 49 slots and is worth 351 thousand. Less space, more money. [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][td][p][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Inventory slots [/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Weight, kg [/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Price, thousands[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]All spots[/p][/td][td][p]66 → 49[/p][/td][td][p]47 → 80[/p][/td][td][p]152 → 352[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b]Faction events — [/b]was 89 slots and 263 thousand, now 73 slots and 407 thousand.[b] [/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][td][p][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Inventory slots[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Weight, kg[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Price, thousands[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Without jackpot[/p][/td][td][p]89 → 73[/p][/td][td][p]87 → 88[/p][/td][td][p]263 → 407[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]With jackpot[/p][/td][td][p]89 → 75[/p][/td][td][p]87 → 90[/p][/td][td][p]263 → 430[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b]Caches[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][td][p][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Inventory slots[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Weight, kg[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Price, thousands[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Without jackpot[/p][/td][td][p]51 → 24[/p][/td][td][p]31 → 22[/p][/td][td][p]44 → 81[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]With jackpot[/p][/td][td][p]50 → 27[/p][/td][td][p]30 → 27[/p][/td][td][p]44 → 109[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Caches changes are additionally described below.[/p][p][b]Important[/b]: We will also update the randomization of final rewards for event clearing in the near future. Instead, a convenient toggle was added to the full stats card, which displays all previously hidden parameters (these are affected by installed attachments, anomalous modules, the upgrade level, and the type of ammunition).[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2504a3136470b7db15a0bc51d1d072ea5d64d30f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]In the Codex comparison, you can now choose to compare weapons based on [b]all[/b] their characteristics.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/52a3be811ba66cc38e714c0f0ab4646824eeacd8.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The visual part of the comparison is updated: compact, easy-to-read arrows are now used instead of bulky scales.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/221ad723dc0d00a735336304b8aaa53cded6fe76.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The display of anomalous modules in the general characteristics is now more compact, and the design of the module cards themselves is also updated.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ae9d2985c5a8d1a3897e3cd0e5005e7ab0c8006a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5b312faf5320cab466bd4e4fba7c1376963bbd0e.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Containers and infections[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The container properties now display infection limits. Once these limits are exceeded, infections begin to accumulate. The system's logic remained unchanged: the limit depends on the character's base protection and the container's internal protection.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9489e008d244de435df340d9a2c02dbf2df0bd27.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Display of infections[/b][/h2][p]For convenience and ease of understanding, the baseline infection rates are adjusted to -10. All damage, including armor and medical item damage, is multiplied by 20.[/p][p]The logic behind how the parameters work has not changed in any way.[/p][p]There is no need to reassemble the builds, the changes are purely visual.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/72822374fba75744c1cfad8449edc5be6fa53eec.png"][/img][/p][p]Consequently, the threshold value for preventing the accumulation of infection in the container is now 10 instead of 0.5, and 20 instead of 1 for cold.[/p][h1][b]Other changes and fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Added charm mount to the SPAS-15.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, when you drag and drop attachments in the inventory, the weapons they can be equipped on are highlighted.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the first-person animation system. If you notice that animations are behaving incorrectly or that sounds are missing from actions where they should be present, please report this to[url="https://support.exbo.games/"] [u]Support team.[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the hand position on the AEK-965 with the grip installed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a delay in the crosshair's movement when entering aim mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to install grips on the MP-155 Ultima.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented users from retrieving multiple emails at once using the Claim Selected button.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected several minor localization bugs in all languages.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Open world economy update
newsitems.author: Vibeeeee
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/034865b85f2a81d0fc774ce702f40843fe29b16a.png"][/img][/p][p]You’ve been waiting, we’ve been waiting, everyone’s been waiting, and finally, the time has come! An update to the open-world economy![/p][p align="start"]In this wall of text, we’ll tell you about the rework of rewards from events, caches, faction containers, protoartifacts, and even gear repairs.[/p][p align="start"]Important! Due to this update, old junk items may be removed and compensated with rubles. Details on this matter will be published separately on our social media.[/p][h2]Contents[/h2][p align="start"]• Faction North[/p][p align="start"]• Events[/p][p align="start"]• Outposts[/p][p align="start"]• Abandoned Installation, Arthunters and Scientists[/p][p align="start"]• Caches[/p][p align="start"]• Jackpots[/p][p align="start"]• Faction containers[/p][p align="start"]• South and Wild North[/p][p align="start"]• Protoartifacts[/p][p align="start"]• Proto-Discharge Cluster and Anomalous Rift[/p][p align="start"]• Gear repairs[/p][h1]Faction North[/h1][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b82d029a4aa5ff73c512f6ea03356b56132b9a3c.png"][/img][/p][h2]Events[/h2][p align="start"]Let’s start with the main thing. Right now, the rewards for clearing events in the Faction North don’t feel valuable enough. Some of the items seem more like junk than a reward for completing an activity in a more dangerous area compared to the South.[/p][p align="start"]To straighten things out, we’ll add new items for sale, while some existing items will receive more convenient characteristics: larger stack sizes, lower weight, and higher value.[/p][p align="start"]Thanks to this, your inventory will fill up more slowly, encumbrance will occur later, and it will become more profitable to take all the items after clearing events.[/p][p align="start"]And, of course, extracting with a full backpack of loot will become more profitable as well![/p][h3]Outposts[/h3][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/872ff3169ef1e974936210e967fc4594d38691a9.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Separately, we’d like to note that we will be changing Outposts rewards. Items sold to Arsenal will become more convenient, but the amount of Arsenal reputation that can be framed will remain at roughly the same level. [b]
[/b][/p][h3]Abandoned Installation, Arthunters, and Scientists[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/009054f265c18c36bd4139e4ef33a3c453c223c8.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The contents of the Abandoned Installation, Arthunters, and Scientists events will also be reworked so that their rewards better correspond to the type of activity.[/p][h2]Caches[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/498e4f827a2f26456dbcea43f393962fdff2887a.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Right now caches are an extremely unprofitable and even dangerous activity that forces you to put your weapon away.[/p][p align="start"]Therefore, we will significantly increase the rewards from caches in the Faction North and revise the items that can be obtained from them. They will take up fewer inventory slots and weigh less.[/p][h2]Jackpots[/h2][p align="start"]We’ll also introduce a “jackpot” mechanic to make caches and NPC events feel less like chores and more like activities that can pleasantly surprise you. [/p][p align="start"]The logic is simple: the more dangerous the location, the higher the chance of getting a jackpot. This will apply especially to the gold NPC events.[/p][h2]Faction Containers[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/dd17725cdc7756cc4ac73c05ea4198127d5f8642.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]You’ve fought your way through half of the North and finally made it to the enemy’s home territory to loot a faction container? Enjoy your well-deserved bag of doritos…[/p][p align="start"]We’ll remove some of the junk items and increase the average income from faction containers.[/p][h2]South and Wild North[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b41514fedbec19210d78a92c8fc55f9f25833630.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]As for the South, we’ll separately put in order its existing loot pool so that it better matches the challenge of the area and doesn’t overlap with northern rewards.[/p][p align="start"]In the Wild North, loot will receive minor updates as part of the overall system so that rewards remain consistent with the progression: South → Faction North → Wild North.[/p][h1]Protoartifacts[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2ae7abe736a7227743eb525456f3edda0c5a9b1c.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Does anyone remember where those several legendary protoartifacts in their stash came from? Neither do we, because right now there is almost no location-based progression when farming protoartifacts: they can be obtained in the South at roughly the same rate as in the North.[/p][h2]Proto-Discharge Cluster and Anomalous Rift[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9edbef78bcac23f9be95e5c5ac30b284054d7604.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Because of this, the northern Proto-Discharge Cluster and Anomalous Rift events remain unpopular, while exclusive and legendary quality protoartifacts have almost disappeared from the economy.[/p][p align="start"]We will introduce location-based progression for farming protoartifacts. Northern territories will become more relevant as a source of rare protoartifacts, but at the same time we will carefully monitor their value so as not to devalue the existing economy.[/p][h2]Gear Repairs[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2697891a0b7bea6e2ad544bab7438fb33475c928.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]As the icing on the cake, we’re also planning to take a separate look at repair costs. And this isn’t about removing money from the economy.[/p][p align="start"]Right now, repairs don’t always seem logical: an armor of a higher rank can sometimes be cheaper to repair, gear of the same tier can have significantly different repair costs, and weapons of the same tier can have different operating costs depending on their caliber.[/p][p align="start"]We’ll review the cost and durability of gear and create a clearer repair calculation model that takes into account the gear type, tier, caliber, and other parameters.[/p][p align="start"]That’s all for now. If anything changes or new details emerge, we’ll be sure to keep you informed, so stay tuned for the news![/p]

newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/18662e05f0ecb3d7a101f7e286d2028acbda57da.png[/img]The Zone not only holds countless mysteries, but also the answers to them. Recently, one of those mysteries was finally solved: the Chain of Decay questline was completed, and the first Nocturnes have already been acquired.

[quote] Players went a long way through countless theories and conjectures, both correct and incorrect, but through their combined efforts, they managed to reach the solution. Congratulations to everyone who took part in this search and especially to the first player to complete it and his teammates: [b]BAZAROMA, Max_Cota, C_Obakevich, and MrXanter[/b]!
 
We would also like to thank everyone who created fan content and simply followed the community's efforts to solve the Chain of Decay mysteries with interest.

We hope this quest gave you new experiences, whether it was the joy of finding the solution or the disappointment of not being the first to reach the goal. [/quote]

We will carefully read through your feedback, and if similar mysteries appear in the game in the future, we will do our best to make them even more interesting and engaging.

[i]In the near future, we will compile a list of people who actively participated in the search and are eligible for additional rewards, which will be sent to their characters.[/i]

newsitems.title: WARNING! High voltage
newsitems.author: favlav
newsitems.contents:
[p][i]Watch video overview of the Patch Notes:[/i][/p][previewyoutube="Wp1BXZvOoRw;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]NOTE FOR NA REGION PLAYERS:[/b][/h2][p]The event described below will begin at [b]6:00 PM (EDT)[/b] on the NA region.[/p][p]We wanted more players to be able to witness the in-game events that lead to the Electrostorm, so we've scheduled them at a more convenient time for the NA region.[/p][p]If you'd like to see how it all begins, head to Forge-11 at [b]5:00 PM (EDT)[/b] and witness it firsthand.[/p][h2][b]Electrostorm[/b][/h2][p]Word around the Bar is that someone at the Forge managed to blow up one of the generators around the Control Сenter. Nobody has claimed responsibility, but the factions are looking suspiciously at each other — and at Typhoon, which has been meddling more and more in the affairs of the Zone’s residents.[/p][p]The explosion didn’t go without consequences.  According to eyewitnesses, a full-blown electrical frenzy has broken out around Forge-11: an anomaly made of pure electricity has appeared above the Control Center, and the sky seems hell-bent on hurling thunder and lightning.[/p][p]How will this cataclysm end — if it ends at all?[/p][h2][b]Event dates[/b][/h2][p]According to weather forecasters, the Electrostorm is expected to last until [b]September 23[/b].[/p][h2][b]What is Electrostorm?[/b][/h2][p]Electrostorm — an anomalous phenomenon at Forge-11 caused by the destruction of one of the facilities near the Control Center. It occurs every hour and lasts 30 minutes.[/p][p]During the Electrostorm, [b]lightning rods[/b] appear on Forge-11, and open-world events are replaced by special ones. You can earn the event currency, [b]Internal[/b], for completing them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9dd388d58a8fa2dbe19c7e9611ef3ecceea9c467.png"][/img][/p][quote][p]The Internal you receive is distributed on a 50/50 basis: half is credited to your account immediately, and you must successfully carry the remaining half out. In the event of death, it will be lost.[/p][/quote][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9c02ffd7a9cb642b2308e5c46edaa9f8e1a98c11.png"][/img][/p][h2]Lightning Rods and artifacts[/h2][p]Lightning Rods are structures that appear on Forge-11 only during an Electrostorm.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/aed80b1e3d3d8f844ebeb01d59bdd7206ea77ea8.png"][/img][/p][p]Once activated, lightning strikes the Lightning Rods. Every lightning strike creates an artifact. In addition to the usual artifacts found in Forge-11 after an event, you can also obtain special event artifacts from the Lightning Rod: Black Hole, Mug, Snares, Timber, or Larva.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fc15c03bcdfd3f795cc887980e54b8c28b268a4c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/672ecdd638c181e011e756979f0c633e680995e7.png"][/img][/p][p]Artifacts are distributed one by one among all players within the Lightning Rod's area of effect. As a result, as long as each participant remains in the active area of the installation, they will receive the same number of artifacts. If a participant leaves the area or dies, the artifacts they did not take from the installation are distributed among the other participants.[/p][p]Here's an example of how it works:
There are two players within the Lightning Rod's range. The first artifact to appear goes to the player who first entered the installation's area, and the next artifact goes to the second player. If the second player leaves the area or dies, their turn passes to the first player.[/p][p]In addition to Lightning Rods, you can find the Black Hole, Mug, Snares, Timber, or Larva after eruptions in various anomalies in Forge-11.[/p][p]Also, during the Electrostorm, an unusual anomaly occurs above one of the generators surrounding the Control Center. It seems to serve as a kind of signpost, but exactly what it points to remains for the most curious researchers to figure out.[/p][h2][b]Event challenges[/b][/h2][p]You can earn even more rewards by completing the event challenges.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/53936828de4d5b5a4600ced8302abf47136e47c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Completed challenges count toward the progress bar for earning a reward. The more challenges you complete, the better the reward![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fa9c9fd7936ed987c794cd274d9bd125735c2fc8.png"][/img][/p][h2]Event shop[/h2][p]You can exchange Internal at the event shop for various rewards:[/p][list][*][p]Aura — style for Buryat SRD[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cab365cb19ee52f9d103b69f3e56ee8aa507c638.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Aeolus — style for Elbrus SRD[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ef250d5baaa0a7984b57549c93dee03eeb3a090e.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Profile background and pattern[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c6fbf4230ce3f2b13f0e9645e0da728fe231dd27.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Various consumables[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4a527cb30250452fdd31f3299522fb376a48d8e1.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Event case — Informer’s Reward[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6c1abf70161afccff4f8382f0a80aea734437841.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2]Electrostorm Researcher Set[/h2][p]Brace yourselves for the Electrostorm! Electrostorm Researcher Set includes useful resources as well as exclusive cosmetic items — everything you need to venture into the heart of the raging anomaly and return with valuable trophies.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c252efda9db8c7e615238a1e7b48892bf419a5ef.png"][/img][/p][p]Pack available until 23.09.2026.[/p][h1]Updated Forge-11 Center[/h1][p]The explosion of one of the generators at Forge-11 not only caused quite a stir, but also transformed the Control Center into something completely unrecognizable![/p][list][*][p]Redesigned the Forge-11 center and its surrounding area.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cd7453a953759a5437009ef779687057bd19ce9e.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Updated visuals and weather in the location.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b932495227ac0dd82d376f748a6aedaaef5c65ee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0dce9eafff59e6ef35fae40c8d30c5ba69a30e1b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/328a3adb1b058952aba295cb947742a7c3aed8a9.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Expanded total area of the complex and the inner ring.[/p][/*][*][p]New buildings have been added inside the ring and along the perimeter of the complex.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/40aecf5c40fdf8bb6589a4c977ff341b15fd6d71.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/eda114984c56df316a1a32eebd2738df082a8471.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added a level 4 Psy-infection at the site of the generator explosion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/bf889e6dcddb3fbaf2866fe2c49dfb50e91da50e.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Increased mobility within the location: many trampolines and zip lines added.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/92bf09bcd3816f1c26d266e94ec97e10af8ce95e.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Increased number of anomalies, including Stasis.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new electrophysical anomaly: Tesla It deals sustained damage to players within its radius.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6d8ec84e3602f4a1f344da6cb0c6fe61ecc9bcfb.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of lootable decorations.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked ZIVCAS stronghold. Now, in addition to static NPCs, there are several groups patrolling the building.[/p][/*][*][p]Metal detectors are installed at many of the complex's entrances.[/p][p]Metal detectors provide advance warning of approaching enemies. When a player passes through the metal detector, an audio alarm sounds and red lights turn on for a few seconds. For the best visual effect, we recommend enabling Light Sources in the graphics settings.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0b5f039bf515744b6e817bec6dfc3a57ab3f2a34.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]Travelling around Forge-11[/h3][list][*][p]Camps with ziplines have been added diagonally from the Forge-11 complex, allowing quick travel to the location.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0d68caf408791b4b6a1390b52b9413578c59b4ed.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/04214086f627b18b717849eb041d82b7c1780cb7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added west and east of Forge-11 Burrows, leading to the opposing side’s stronghold.[/p][p]The western Burrow leads to the eastern stronghold, and the eastern Burrow leads to the western one.[/p][p]The exit point from the Burrow is determined randomly, so it may drop you into a potentially dangerous place.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/237f92facdbf44ba70bfc1b09d60c1bdc25374ca.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Content[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Ticketopia Event[/p][/*][*][p]End of Electrostorm[/p][/*][*][p]Working Man’s Cut on NA server[/p][/*][*][p]1000 level style — Air Seller[/p][/*][*][p]New quest — Shock wave [/p][/*][*][p]Economy, rewards and progression[/p][/*][*][p]Modification window update[/p][/*][*][p]Making Safe Zone more lively[/p][/*][*][p]Balance changes[/p][/*][*][p]Other changes and fixes[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Ticketopia Event[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/a9fbab5406ab5493254a1eab1edbd05220fd90fa.png"][/img][/p][p]In autumn, not only leaves fall from the trees, but also Act Tickets, which can be obtained for PvE challenges or for challenges in the Coliseum. The event will run from October 14 to 28.[/p][p]There will be 16 challenges in the event, 8 for each format. You can complete them in any combination: either 8 in PvE, or 8 in the Coliseum, or 4 and 4.[/p][h3][b]Locations to complete PvE challenges[/b][/h3][p]They are only available in the North, Wild North and Lyubech-3. Challenges will not be completed in the peaceful South. Also, the reward does not depend on the selected location.[/p][h3][b]What challenges will there be[/b][/h3][list][*][p]PvE: only open-world activities not tied to direct competition with other players. Outposts, airdrops, and installations in the Wild North do not count.[/p][/*][*][p]Coliseum: destroying enemy squads, capturing installations, activating rifts, and other tasks.[/p][/*][/list][p]The remaining challenges will be announced when the event begins.[/p][h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3][p]For each completed challenge, a small reward is given. Larger rewards are granted for reaching certain milestones of completed challenges:[/p][list][*][p]2 challenges: 100 Act Tickets[/p][/*][*][p]4 challenges: 150 Act Tickets[/p][/*][*][p]6 challenges: Veil style for Albatross Interceptor. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ed413b6d3ad14b1b6d1736cec72067dc8d891111.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]8 challenges: 250 Act Tickets[/p][/*][/list][p]To claim the main prizes, you only need to complete any 8 out of 16 challenges, freely mixing both formats.[/p][h1][b]End of Electrostorm[/b][/h1][p]The event has come to an end. The styles that were obtainable during the event can now be sold to Zen in exchange for season currency.[/p][h1]Working Man’s Cut on NA server[/h1][p]Honest workers deserve honest rewards. A new event where ordinary North hard workers can get everything they're owed for the work they do every day.[/p][p]At Mines, Inflow, Black Detour and Reflection events yield 20% more income — signals and stashes appear 20% more frequently as well. And don't forget about deliveries: even light cargo is valued three times higher.[/p][p]Challenges can only be completed at Mines, Inflow, Black Detour and Reflection.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/699b46c88139282efe897fe430fb2118387b1340.png"][/img][/p][p]Completing challenges rewards you with anomalous serum and other valuable resources. This event is planned to run regularly, and your activity and feedback can influence this.[/p][h1][b]1000 level style — Air Seller[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/48ad7774614fe63d06512b7500b7f65cdf78c87c.png"][/img][/p][p]It's unknown how much the crafter loved Belyaev's books, but that's exactly what he named his creation.[/p][p]The gun reliably produces an air base, enough to subdue enemies without using gunpowder. Those lucky ones who held it says it coughs slightly — something the gunsmith always denies.[/p][h1][b]New quest — Shock wave [/b][/h1][p]Gunfire can be heard near the base — right at the walls! Who could it be? The answer to this question will drag you into a whirlwind of industrial espionage and intrigues among the big players. And as everyone knows, the most unpleasant secrets are hidden under the biggest carpet. Like what happened at Forge-11 when the sky began to fall...[/p][h1][b]Economy, rewards and progression[/b][/h1][p]We've reworked the reward system and economy to make progression across locations more tangible and strengthen the position of the Faction North. Certain activities have also received a significant reward buff. [/p][p][b]Now you're farming more than before. [/b]Here's why:[/p][p]Previously, inventories got clogged with junk — small items took up space and were worth almost nothing.[/p][p]According to the analytics data, players did not claim nearly half of the event rewards due to their low value and excess inventory space.[/p][p]We've reworked rewards on the Faction North, aligning them ideologically with Wild North rewards. Fillers now take up less space and are worth more — the value of a player's inventory relative to its weight has increased.[/p][p][b]Let's show the numbers using Mines as an example: [/b][/p][p]Let’s say you came to a location and cleared 100 events: previously, just under half of the items awarded as rewards for clearing events were of extremely low value. As a result, receiving them was often seen more as a burden than a useful reward: players frequently sent such items to the Trash to avoid taking up inventory space.[/p][p]With the update to the reward pool, the value of the items awarded will increase, making it worthwhile for players to collect each one.[/p][p]The tables below show the results of our calculations for two scenarios: under current player behavior, where low-value items are not collected, and after the reward system is changed, when players will collect all awarded items.[/p][p][b]Mutants[/b] — previously loot occupied 66 inventory slots and was worth 152 thousand. Now it takes 49 slots and is worth 351 thousand. Instead, a convenient toggle was added to the full stats card, which displays all previously hidden parameters (these are affected by installed attachments, anomalous modules, the upgrade level, and the type of ammunition).[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2504a3136470b7db15a0bc51d1d072ea5d64d30f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]In the Codex comparison, you can now choose to compare weapons based on [b]all[/b] their characteristics.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/52a3be811ba66cc38e714c0f0ab4646824eeacd8.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The visual part of the comparison is updated: compact, easy-to-read arrows are now used instead of bulky scales.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/221ad723dc0d00a735336304b8aaa53cded6fe76.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The display of anomalous modules in the general characteristics is now more compact, and the design of the module cards themselves is also updated.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ae9d2985c5a8d1a3897e3cd0e5005e7ab0c8006a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5b312faf5320cab466bd4e4fba7c1376963bbd0e.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Containers and infections[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The container properties now display infection limits. newsitems.title: Open world economy update
newsitems.author: Vibeeeee
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/034865b85f2a81d0fc774ce702f40843fe29b16a.png"][/img][/p][p]You’ve been waiting, we’ve been waiting, everyone’s been waiting, and finally, the time has come! An update to the open-world economy![/p][p align="start"]In this wall of text, we’ll tell you about the rework of rewards from events, caches, faction containers, protoartifacts, and even gear repairs.[/p][p align="start"]Important! Due to this update, old junk items may be removed and compensated with rubles. Details on this matter will be published separately on our social media.[/p][h2]Contents[/h2][p align="start"]• Faction North[/p][p align="start"]• Events[/p][p align="start"]• Outposts[/p][p align="start"]• Abandoned Installation, Arthunters and Scientists[/p][p align="start"]• Caches[/p][p align="start"]• Jackpots[/p][p align="start"]• Faction containers[/p][p align="start"]• South and Wild North[/p][p align="start"]• Protoartifacts[/p][p align="start"]• Proto-Discharge Cluster and Anomalous Rift[/p][p align="start"]• Gear repairs[/p][h1]Faction North[/h1][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b82d029a4aa5ff73c512f6ea03356b56132b9a3c.png"][/img][/p][h2]Events[/h2][p align="start"]Let’s start with the main thing. Right now, the rewards for clearing events in the Faction North don’t feel valuable enough. Some of the items seem more like junk than a reward for completing an activity in a more dangerous area compared to the South.[/p][p align="start"]To straighten things out, we’ll add new items for sale, while some existing items will receive more convenient characteristics: larger stack sizes, lower weight, and higher value.[/p][p align="start"]Thanks to this, your inventory will fill up more slowly, encumbrance will occur later, and it will become more profitable to take all the items after clearing events.[/p][p align="start"]And, of course, extracting with a full backpack of loot will become more profitable as well![/p][h3]Outposts[/h3][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/872ff3169ef1e974936210e967fc4594d38691a9.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Separately, we’d like to note that we will be changing Outposts rewards. Items sold to Arsenal will become more convenient, but the amount of Arsenal reputation that can be framed will remain at roughly the same level. [b]
[/b][/p][h3]Abandoned Installation, Arthunters, and Scientists[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/009054f265c18c36bd4139e4ef33a3c453c223c8.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The contents of the Abandoned Installation, Arthunters, and Scientists events will also be reworked so that their rewards better correspond to the type of activity.[/p][h2]Caches[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/498e4f827a2f26456dbcea43f393962fdff2887a.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Right now caches are an extremely unprofitable and even dangerous activity that forces you to put your weapon away.[/p][p align="start"]Therefore, we will significantly increase the rewards from caches in the Faction North and revise the items that can be obtained from them. They will take up fewer inventory slots and weigh less.[/p][h2]Jackpots[/h2][p align="start"]We’ll also introduce a “jackpot” mechanic to make caches and NPC events feel less like chores and more like activities that can pleasantly surprise you. [/p][p align="start"]The logic is simple: the more dangerous the location, the higher the chance of getting a jackpot. This will apply especially to the gold NPC events.[/p][h2]Faction Containers[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/dd17725cdc7756cc4ac73c05ea4198127d5f8642.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]You’ve fought your way through half of the North and finally made it to the enemy’s home territory to loot a faction container? Enjoy your well-deserved bag of doritos…[/p][p align="start"]We’ll remove some of the junk items and increase the average income from faction containers.[/p][h2]South and Wild North[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b41514fedbec19210d78a92c8fc55f9f25833630.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]As for the South, we’ll separately put in order its existing loot pool so that it better matches the challenge of the area and doesn’t overlap with northern rewards.[/p][p align="start"]In the Wild North, loot will receive minor updates as part of the overall system so that rewards remain consistent with the progression: South → Faction North → Wild North.[/p][h1]Protoartifacts[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2ae7abe736a7227743eb525456f3edda0c5a9b1c.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Does anyone remember where those several legendary protoartifacts in their stash came from? Neither do we, because right now there is almost no location-based progression when farming protoartifacts: they can be obtained in the South at roughly the same rate as in the North.[/p][h2]Proto-Discharge Cluster and Anomalous Rift[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9edbef78bcac23f9be95e5c5ac30b284054d7604.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Because of this, the northern Proto-Discharge Cluster and Anomalous Rift events remain unpopular, while exclusive and legendary quality protoartifacts have almost disappeared from the economy.[/p][p align="start"]We will introduce location-based progression for farming protoartifacts. Northern territories will become more relevant as a source of rare protoartifacts, but at the same time we will carefully monitor their value so as not to devalue the existing economy.[/p][h2]Gear Repairs[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2697891a0b7bea6e2ad544bab7438fb33475c928.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]As the icing on the cake, we’re also planning to take a separate look at repair costs. And this isn’t about removing money from the economy.[/p][p align="start"]Right now, repairs don’t always seem logical: an armor of a higher rank can sometimes be cheaper to repair, gear of the same tier can have significantly different repair costs, and weapons of the same tier can have different operating costs depending on their caliber.[/p][p align="start"]We’ll review the cost and durability of gear and create a clearer repair calculation model that takes into account the gear type, tier, caliber, and other parameters.[/p][p align="start"]That’s all for now. If anything changes or new details emerge, we’ll be sure to keep you informed, so stay tuned for the news![/p]

The main goal of the update is to bring the duel maps in line with the game's current visual style.[/p][p]This is the first batch of updated locations. The remaining duel maps are also in progress, and you'll soon get to see their new look.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/266235e6536ea7ab0837b3a9e0408a5ab53b8d4b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8ed78da9127bf320a8e655505671854ff13296bb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c5ba4e51380a02fb6b725f3ed406072f22648860.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9fc9f2df2b9e5869573c912962cf1a57cc4f11c0.png"][/img][/carousel][h1][b]Zen selling list update[/b][/h1][p]Updated list of items that Zen buys with season currency.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Pancor Jackhammer[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Centipede style for TEC-9[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Diapason style for Brigand[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Rat King style for Phantom Hunter[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Shout style for Steyr AUG A3[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Cauterizer[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Ice Pick[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Bone Knife[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Ritual Hatchet[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Cleaver[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Old Sickle[/p][/td][/tr][/table][h1][b]First Season Pack[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5a76e3736ec4c7c7790c3a517a2e40ecbf5d8750.png"][/img][/p][p]A vague silhouette that appears with every mention. newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/d25cd6465e83819c9d4db5e800a9d72ef40e3a86.png"][/img][b]Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Electrostorm event fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Typhoon Scout Supplies[/p][/*][*][p]Other changes and fixes[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Electrostorm event fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Reduced the maximum number of players per Forge-11 instance.[/p][/*][*][p]During Electrostorm, 3 Lightning Rods are now active simultaneously.[/p][/*][*][p]Destroy mutants during Electrostorm task now requires 300 mutant kills instead of 500.[/p][/*][*][p]Due to the reduced player limit per Forge-11 instance, the number of artifacts spawned after eruptions is reduced by 28%.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the drop rates of Snares and Mug spawned after eruptions. They now have the same drop chance as Larva, Black Hole, and Timber.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the chances of artifacts rarity generated by Lightning Rods due to the addition of a third Lightning Rod, while increasing the overall number of artifacts they generate.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the chances of the following artifacts spawn while generated by Lightning Rod: Dumbbell, Amberite, Frame, Bracelet, Steel Hedgehog, Scrubber, Snake Eye, Polyhedron, Gum, Helium, Transformer, Mirror, Spiral, Shard, Atom, Prism, Sun, Radiator, Viburnum Branch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Internal could drop from ZIVCAS Raid event.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Zombie, ZIVCAS, and Mutant events would not spawn in some Forge-11 instances. [/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Typhoon Scout Supplies[/b][/h1][p]Typhoon scouts are used to taking on missions of any difficulty, but the Zone presents challenges that no foreign unit can truly prepare for. Harsh conditions and relentless anomalous activity force these elite operatives to constantly adapt just to stay alive.[/p][p]To support their missions and make adapting to the Zone a little easier, we've added the Typhoon Scout Supply pack. It contains everything needed to overcome the hardships of survival, and now you can stock up on these supplies as well.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/46ab08bde482a2085949cdb0eea0f7c00159e4b7.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Other changes and fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Burrow in the center of Forge-11 now leads to your faction's base.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the icons for possible rewards were displayed incorrectly in the event tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]Added display of Season Pass progress points.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the timer element in the Lightning Rod and Chronorift event interfaces was sticking to the center of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Electrostorm event challenges description.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where most paints could not be applied to the Capper.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Changes that were made to the game in previous updates:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Moved the antenna on the Aeolus style from the left to the right side;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where using the Burrow leading to the Arsenal Workshop counted toward the progress of the Leave Forge-11 through Burrow challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect positioning of the attachments on the foregrip of the Sandy Lock style.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the missing paint mask on the Inscribed style.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the cost of refreshing weekly Operations tasks and basic сompletion reward reroll.[/p][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Old Cost[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]New Cost[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Basic completion reward reroll[/p][/td][td][p]30 000[/p][/td][td][p]15 000[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Weekly tasks refresh[/p][/td][td][p]500 000[/p][/td][td][p]300 000[/p][/td][/tr][/table]

newsitems.title: Chain of Decay — The Search Is Over!
newsitems.author: GoblinLootLord
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/18662e05f0ecb3d7a101f7e286d2028acbda57da.png[/img]The Zone not only holds countless mysteries, but also the answers to them. Recently, one of those mysteries was finally solved: the Chain of Decay questline was completed, and the first Nocturnes have already been acquired.

[quote] Players went a long way through countless theories and conjectures, both correct and incorrect, but through their combined efforts, they managed to reach the solution. Congratulations to everyone who took part in this search and especially to the first player to complete it and his teammates: [b]BAZAROMA, Max_Cota, C_Obakevich, and MrXanter[/b]!
 
We would also like to thank everyone who created fan content and simply followed the community's efforts to solve the Chain of Decay mysteries with interest.

We hope this quest gave you new experiences, whether it was the joy of finding the solution or the disappointment of not being the first to reach the goal. [/quote]

We will carefully read through your feedback, and if similar mysteries appear in the game in the future, we will do our best to make them even more interesting and engaging.

[i]In the near future, we will compile a list of people who actively participated in the search and are eligible for additional rewards, which will be sent to their characters.[/i]

newsitems.title: WARNING! High voltage
newsitems.author: favlav
newsitems.contents:
[p][i]Watch video overview of the Patch Notes:[/i][/p][previewyoutube="Wp1BXZvOoRw;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]NOTE FOR NA REGION PLAYERS:[/b][/h2][p]The event described below will begin at [b]6:00 PM (EDT)[/b] on the NA region.[/p][p]We wanted more players to be able to witness the in-game events that lead to the Electrostorm, so we've scheduled them at a more convenient time for the NA region.[/p][p]If you'd like to see how it all begins, head to Forge-11 at [b]5:00 PM (EDT)[/b] and witness it firsthand.[/p][h2][b]Electrostorm[/b][/h2][p]Word around the Bar is that someone at the Forge managed to blow up one of the generators around the Control Сenter. Nobody has claimed responsibility, but the factions are looking suspiciously at each other — and at Typhoon, which has been meddling more and more in the affairs of the Zone’s residents.[/p][p]The explosion didn’t go without consequences.  According to eyewitnesses, a full-blown electrical frenzy has broken out around Forge-11: an anomaly made of pure electricity has appeared above the Control Center, and the sky seems hell-bent on hurling thunder and lightning.[/p][p]How will this cataclysm end — if it ends at all?[/p][h2][b]Event dates[/b][/h2][p]According to weather forecasters, the Electrostorm is expected to last until [b]September 23[/b].[/p][h2][b]What is Electrostorm?[/b][/h2][p]Electrostorm — an anomalous phenomenon at Forge-11 caused by the destruction of one of the facilities near the Control Center. It occurs every hour and lasts 30 minutes.[/p][p]During the Electrostorm, [b]lightning rods[/b] appear on Forge-11, and open-world events are replaced by special ones. You can earn the event currency, [b]Internal[/b], for completing them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9dd388d58a8fa2dbe19c7e9611ef3ecceea9c467.png"][/img][/p][quote][p]The Internal you receive is distributed on a 50/50 basis: half is credited to your account immediately, and you must successfully carry the remaining half out. In the event of death, it will be lost.[/p][/quote][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9c02ffd7a9cb642b2308e5c46edaa9f8e1a98c11.png"][/img][/p][h2]Lightning Rods and artifacts[/h2][p]Lightning Rods are structures that appear on Forge-11 only during an Electrostorm.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/aed80b1e3d3d8f844ebeb01d59bdd7206ea77ea8.png"][/img][/p][p]Once activated, lightning strikes the Lightning Rods. Every lightning strike creates an artifact. In addition to the usual artifacts found in Forge-11 after an event, you can also obtain special event artifacts from the Lightning Rod: Black Hole, Mug, Snares, Timber, or Larva.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fc15c03bcdfd3f795cc887980e54b8c28b268a4c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/672ecdd638c181e011e756979f0c633e680995e7.png"][/img][/p][p]Artifacts are distributed one by one among all players within the Lightning Rod's area of effect. As a result, as long as each participant remains in the active area of the installation, they will receive the same number of artifacts. If a participant leaves the area or dies, the artifacts they did not take from the installation are distributed among the other participants.[/p][p]Here's an example of how it works:
There are two players within the Lightning Rod's range. The first artifact to appear goes to the player who first entered the installation's area, and the next artifact goes to the second player. If the second player leaves the area or dies, their turn passes to the first player.[/p][p]In addition to Lightning Rods, you can find the Black Hole, Mug, Snares, Timber, or Larva after eruptions in various anomalies in Forge-11.[/p][p]Also, during the Electrostorm, an unusual anomaly occurs above one of the generators surrounding the Control Center. It seems to serve as a kind of signpost, but exactly what it points to remains for the most curious researchers to figure out.[/p][h2][b]Event challenges[/b][/h2][p]You can earn even more rewards by completing the event challenges.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/53936828de4d5b5a4600ced8302abf47136e47c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Completed challenges count toward the progress bar for earning a reward. The more challenges you complete, the better the reward![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fa9c9fd7936ed987c794cd274d9bd125735c2fc8.png"][/img][/p][h2]Event shop[/h2][p]You can exchange Internal at the event shop for various rewards:[/p][list][*][p]Aura — style for Buryat SRD[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cab365cb19ee52f9d103b69f3e56ee8aa507c638.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Aeolus — style for Elbrus SRD[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ef250d5baaa0a7984b57549c93dee03eeb3a090e.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Profile background and pattern[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c6fbf4230ce3f2b13f0e9645e0da728fe231dd27.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Various consumables[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4a527cb30250452fdd31f3299522fb376a48d8e1.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Event case — Informer’s Reward[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6c1abf70161afccff4f8382f0a80aea734437841.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2]Electrostorm Researcher Set[/h2][p]Brace yourselves for the Electrostorm! Electrostorm Researcher Set includes useful resources as well as exclusive cosmetic items — everything you need to venture into the heart of the raging anomaly and return with valuable trophies.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c252efda9db8c7e615238a1e7b48892bf419a5ef.png"][/img][/p][p]Pack available until 23.09.2026.[/p][h1]Updated Forge-11 Center[/h1][p]The explosion of one of the generators at Forge-11 not only caused quite a stir, but also transformed the Control Center into something completely unrecognizable![/p][list][*][p]Redesigned the Forge-11 center and its surrounding area.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cd7453a953759a5437009ef779687057bd19ce9e.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Updated visuals and weather in the location.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/b932495227ac0dd82d376f748a6aedaaef5c65ee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0dce9eafff59e6ef35fae40c8d30c5ba69a30e1b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/328a3adb1b058952aba295cb947742a7c3aed8a9.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Expanded total area of the complex and the inner ring.[/p][/*][*][p]New buildings have been added inside the ring and along the perimeter of the complex.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/40aecf5c40fdf8bb6589a4c977ff341b15fd6d71.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/eda114984c56df316a1a32eebd2738df082a8471.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added a level 4 Psy-infection at the site of the generator explosion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/bf889e6dcddb3fbaf2866fe2c49dfb50e91da50e.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Increased mobility within the location: many trampolines and zip lines added.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/92bf09bcd3816f1c26d266e94ec97e10af8ce95e.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Increased number of anomalies, including Stasis.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new electrophysical anomaly: Tesla It deals sustained damage to players within its radius.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6d8ec84e3602f4a1f344da6cb0c6fe61ecc9bcfb.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of lootable decorations.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked ZIVCAS stronghold. Now, in addition to static NPCs, there are several groups patrolling the building.[/p][/*][*][p]Metal detectors are installed at many of the complex's entrances.[/p][p]Metal detectors provide advance warning of approaching enemies. When a player passes through the metal detector, an audio alarm sounds and red lights turn on for a few seconds. For the best visual effect, we recommend enabling Light Sources in the graphics settings.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0b5f039bf515744b6e817bec6dfc3a57ab3f2a34.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]Travelling around Forge-11[/h3][list][*][p]Camps with ziplines have been added diagonally from the Forge-11 complex, allowing quick travel to the location.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0d68caf408791b4b6a1390b52b9413578c59b4ed.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/04214086f627b18b717849eb041d82b7c1780cb7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added west and east of Forge-11 Burrows, leading to the opposing side’s stronghold.[/p][p]The western Burrow leads to the eastern stronghold, and the eastern Burrow leads to the western one.[/p][p]The exit point from the Burrow is determined randomly, so it may drop you into a potentially dangerous place.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Patch Notes [02.09.2026]
newsitems.author: Morty
newsitems.contents:
[p][i]Watch video overview of the Patch Notes:[/i][/p][previewyoutube="Wp1BXZvOoRw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Stalkers are talking about something that cannot be perceived or understood. People are abandoning their gear, leaving their routes, and swearing they felt someone else’s presence.[/p][p]More and more experienced stalkers are turning back to superstitions.[/p][p]The Zone is filling with primal fear.[/p][h2][b]Contents[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Season: tulpa![/p][/*][*][p]Season Pass menu change[/p][/*][*][p]Economy adjustments for the Operations mode[/p][/*][*][p]Tasks display[/p][/*][*][p]Guide updates[/p][/*][*][p]Coliseum season tasks adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Player profile change[/p][/*][*][p]Balance adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Other changes and fixes[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Season: tulpa![/b][/h1][h2][b]Autumn weather[/b][/h2][p]Autumn has reached the Zone: leaves are slowly falling, painting familiar landscapes in rusty tones.[/p][list][*][p]The vegetation palette has been updated to match the autumn season.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the visuals for weather effects. During some of them, falling leaves can be observed.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visuals for wind and thunderstorms.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/047ee3c29d40ef0124b81338e6dfe7ca08f7671d.png"][/img][/p][p]Throughout autumn, the following weather conditions can be seen:[/p][list][*][p]Cloudy weather;[/p][/*][*][p]Overcast weather;[/p][/*][*][p]Light fog;[/p][/*][*][p]Dense fog;[/p][/*][*][p]Light rain;[/p][/*][*][p]Heavy rain;[/p][/*][*][p]Thunderstorm.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Season rewards[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7f6a2b703a97c468f5d8a0a3a4a4c6cfaa1d5c8a.png"][/img][/p][p]Updated the key Season Pass rewards:[/p][list][*][p]OTs-62;[/p][/*][*][p]ALK-22 Dragonfly;[/p][/*][*][p]Ratcatcher Exoarmor;[/p][/*][*][p]Leper skin;[/p][/*][*][p]Turmoil paint сontainer;[/p][/*][*][p]Amulet doll charm;[/p][/*][*][p]All-Seeing Fishie charm;[/p][/*][*][p]tulpa! customization pack.[/p][/*][/list][p]
And the main Season Pass reward — [b]Capper[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/af51a2c02ea67ba60e64cdb4a978033f85e1adbc.png"][/img]The new sniper rifle features a unique charge mechanic that lets you choose between firing instantly or dealing maximum damage.[/p][list][*][p]Pressing the fire button immediately shoots with low damage, comparable to a veteran M40A5 using SBP ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Holding the fire button begins charging the shot. A full charge takes 0.5 seconds and increases damage to nearly Gauss Rifle levels. While charging, movement speed is reduced by 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]You can fire at any point during the charge, but the longer you hold the button, the higher the damage. Most of the damage increase occurs in the final moments before the charge is complete.[/p][/*][*][p]At full charge, the shot gains an additional property: armor plate penetration.[/p][/*][*][p]After reaching full charge, the weapon can remain charged for an additional [b]3 seconds[/b]. If you don’t fire within that time, the charge is lost.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Special case[/b][/h2][p]Added a new Season Special case, featuring a unique reward — K15 machine gun.[/p][p]Key rewards and contents:[/p][list][*][p]K15;[/p][/*][*][p]CD-4 Armored Suit;[/p][/*][*][p]Elbrus SRD;[/p][/*][*][p]CRAW-6 Container;[/p][/*][*][p]HK417;[/p][/*][*][p]FN SCAR-H.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3e6fd7a992aa8a46ec05a2bc80dfbf1707237b4c.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Season Pass menu change[/b][/h1][p]Updated the main rewards interaction menu. You can now switch between key rewards using the cards in the top-right corner.[/p][p]Visual changes:[/p][list][*][p]Level progress and Season Pass buttons moved to the season description block;[/p][/*][*][p]The Go to my level and Claim rewards buttons moved to the bottom control panel.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/66cac83cd291955564b14f1dd99e0bba87ae8037.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Economy adjustments for the Operations mode[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/4625ed49b59da4e3d433d1e410b5dfd2b52de31c.png"][/img][/p][p]For a long time, the high profitability of the Operations mode limited our ability to increase rewards for open-world activities.[/p][p]The current Operations economy allows players to earn extremely high guaranteed income without significant risks or costs. This disrupts the reward structure logic we aim for across the game and is unfair to players engaging in riskier, more resource-intensive activities. Therefore, it was decided to reduce this mode’s profitability in favor of increasing open-world rewards.[/p][p]Economic changes will be implemented in two iterations:[/p][p]First iteration — reducing Operations mode profitability on September 2, 2026. 
Second iteration — increasing profitability in permanent open-world events, planned for late September/early October.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed money reward reduced by 70%.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the amount of advanced parts, tools, and currency in the potential reward pool.[/p][/*][*][p]The probability of receiving Advanced Tools in rewards is reduced, and the probability of receiving Advanced Parts is increased.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Tasks display[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Receiving a side quest no longer replaces the active main quest. The main quest retains the highest priority and continues to be displayed at the top of the interface.[/p][/*][*][p]During eruptions, Find cover quest always has the highest priority and temporarily overrides the display of other quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Objectives for the main and side quests can now be displayed simultaneously. You can also manually hide or pin them.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fb82a4c3c77de217fef27d6aa43e7454f1a3495d.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Open world events that can be used to complete an active quest are now marked with a special indicator.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/40ba18fdb32586be0db5273f3ba752e442c0444a.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Subdivision Battles[/b][/h1][p]The next ranked season will begin on September 17 and run until October 10.[/p][h1][b]Guide updates[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Tables can now be used in articles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues related to item display in the Codex.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the following items to the Codex: Cryomancer, SIX12 Trailblazers of the North, and Ivan-1 style.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded and translated articles on signals, events, additional effects, and other game mechanics.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Coliseum season tasks changes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Successful installation capture, Activate the rift, Intercept the generator, Eliminate the enemy squad tasks now count as a single task.[/p][/*][*][p]Eliminate the enemy squad task now requires eliminating 3 enemy squads instead of 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Activate the rift task now requires activating 3 rifts instead of 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Intercept the generator task now requires 4 interceptions instead of 3.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Player profile change[/b][/h1][h2][b]Profile music[/b][/h2][p]You can now add tracks from records to your profile.[/p][list][*][p]A new Music section is now available in the profile customisation window.[/p][/*][*][p]Just like on the card's page, you can find all the records available in the game there and learn how to obtain them.[/p][/*][*][p]For a track in your profile, you can select any segment that is at least 1 second long.[/p][/*][*][p]By default, the track plays when you enter your profile. Once you press Pause, this status is retained when you access any profile.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/afa0321a3ec78ab16399930038ba57a0189a691c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9c25caf6346df5488e243c65d2f7058e3009de6c.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Display of the player's current gear in the profile[/b][/h2][p]Now, all equipped items on a character are displayed in the profile next to the Statistics window. You can hide items from other players using a special button.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2ce3b050a47cbc9e71529e25ae0c9cc0b859beef.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9f33973802b0638934e7b53089bbab1f12369a01.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]In-game shop update[/b][/h1][h2][b]Pack chain[/b][/h2][p]To help you get started quickly, a series of packs awaits you, containing Season Pass levels, Overdrives, Fishie Crates, and Night Stalks paint for armor and weapons.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9d80143919442239b9ea63195a720504d82a8c7f.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Styles[/b][/h3][p][i]“I've seen a lot in my life, but something staring at me from the darkness...”[/i] — some strangers around the campfire.[/p][p]There are many rumors about unexplained phenomena occurring in the Zone. Some people blame it on the antics of stalkers, while others believe in a different, more terrifying and frightening force. Superstitions styles pack was crafted by artisans specifically for those who want to ensure their journey goes smoothly — after all, superstitions should be kept at bay.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3e51293876c23e44fcc0998df3c9a0dc86ee7942.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Balance adjustments[/b][/h1][h3][b]Grenades[/b][/h3][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p align="center"][b]Grenade[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Changes[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]
